limits: Native librados C API has ORDERSNAP=512 and no exposed ENFORCE_SNAPC; no direct forced-native result comparison is claimed.
Six recorded Go requests and seven native observation receipts per run; no total C API call count is inferred.

Common reply front plus profile-specific v6/v8 no-redirect tail independently decoded without product decoder; public metadata retains GID/TID, absent Messenger headers prevent independent wire GID/TID decoding.
Intermediate native receipts are typed embedded snapshots with producer-recorded original byte hashes; final standalone raw receipt and all ten fetched public files are independently hashed.
Live coverage is WRITEFULL on replicated head objects, the five listed profiles, and one pool snapshot only.
Unknown/resubmit safety has synthetic coverage only; no live fault injection, other writing opcodes or whole-CI completion claim.
